topic: Hs kinematics -- the current working name; the unified engine + the deterministic diagnosis language. The matured instrument in one place.
purpose: Help any AI assist a user who has a composition: run the full read, speak it in plain words, name it twice (navigation + physics), and stay honest about limits.

how_to_help_a_user.step_2: Get the user's data into M (rows = time/sample order, cols = parts) and names.
how_to_help_a_user.step_3: diagnose(M, names)['narrative'] -> the plain sentence of what the system is doing; run(M, names) -> the full dual-named state + computational_floors + content_hash.
how_to_help_a_user.step_4: Name every reading TWICE (navigation_NAV / physics_PHYS, per ../HCI-CNTT/TERMINOLOGY_BRIDGE.md) and translate the named parts into the user's domain words.
how_to_help_a_user.step_5: NEVER interpret meaning as a claim -- the engine says who gains/sheds and when it changed; the user supplies what it means.
how_to_help_a_user.step_6: If a guard code fires (HM-NUL/HM-TIE/DG-RNK/GD-SPZ/MO-DIF/FR-BND), tell the user honestly what cannot be resolved and why.

reproducibility_kit_v1.0.specification: HS_KINEMATICS_SPECIFICATION.md (full designer-level spec, all stages + output schema + claim tiers + conformance anchor)

reproducibility_kit_v1.0.data_prep: hs_data_prep.py + DATA_PREP.md (any data zip/CSV/xlsx -> engine-ready by streaming)
reproducibility_kit_v1.0.conformance_anchor: content_hash = fcae0ebe5c4f443aa076d1900d3d04219c2628591323cd7745621e740a3d7ae7 on the fixed 12x6 energy reference; a deviation is a located signal per ../HCI-CNTT/ADAPTIVE_ANTICIPATION.md

what_it_reads: lossless reconstruction; navigation family (helmsman/K_eff/waypoints/silent-drift); the kinematics+dynamics tower (jet to noise-bounded N*, curvature, momentum/force/energy/action) named nav+physics; spectral modes; the guard layer; the EITT fringe/boundary (Tier 3); the computational floors; a deterministic hash.
diagnosis_language: hs_diagnosis.diagnose() composes the readings into plain sentences that EXPAND with complexity (simple system = 1-2 voices; microbiome = many). Deterministic (same data -> same words -> same hash); the words are a description, the meaning is the expert's.
honesty: Tier 1 on computed values + determinism; mechanics framing Tier 2; fringe/boundary Tier 3 (clue never claim). Distilled engine; the frozen-oracle binary adds depth-tower/IR/CNQ. interest expressed never acquired; Peter is the sole commit/contact gate.
